verdict: Avoid for now — Delhi demand signals are running behind India and the data-based call is Avoid; lend only to export-linked, low-leverage precision shops with clean receivables, and decline the rest.
title: Narela-Bawana fabrication & machining: a note to the credit manager
narrative: Capex is CNC/VMC machines and power; working capital is inventory plus receivables, and ICRA's methodology notes working capital is driven by receivables and inventory holding [5]. **So when a proposal lands, check the receivable days against the customer mix first; if one buyer is over a third of sales, ask for that buyer's payment history and whether the shop is a single-source vendor.**

## What has changed now
**Delhi is lagging the country on both demand proxies: GST collections +2.7% Apr-to-date against India +6.1%, and electricity demand +6.5% against India +9.5% [D].** That is a local stress signal, and the repo at 5.5%, raised from 5.25% with a tightening stance, makes the interest line heavier [D]. **The data-based call is Avoid (score 27), so the bar for any new limit is high.** Note the sources say nothing specific about Narela-Bawana itself — I am leaning on first principles and the peer set, and you should treat the absence of local data as a reason to collect from customer, not to assume health.

## Where the growth is
**The peers that are growing are export-linked and precision-focused, not local-job-work.** Rolex Rings reports international sales at 73% of bearing rings revenue and 72% of auto components revenue [1]; Kranti Industries grew H1 FY26 revenue 13.9% year-on-year [2]; Balu Forge posted 27.2% EBITDA margin in Q3FY26 [3]; Ramkrishna Forgings grew Q2 revenue 54.9% with EBITDA margin at 18.2% [4]. **Pursue the Narela-Bawana shops that supply tier-1 auto or export chains with documented purchase orders; avoid the pure local fabrication shops dependent on Delhi construction and general engineering, where the demand signal is weakest [D].**

## How to grow safely
**Structure short: cash-credit against receivables, term loan only for a named machine with a customer order behind it.** Take monthly: GST returns, receivable ageing by buyer, machine-hour utilisation, and electricity bills — the last ties directly to the local demand signal [D]. **Covenant on receivable days and on leverage; ICRA notes low leverage preserves financial flexibility in a downturn [6].** If the buyer concentration rises or ageing stretches, ask for the buyer's ledger confirmation before enhancing.

## Early warning signs
**Watch for receivable days stretching while sales stay flat, and for power consumption falling without a stated shutdown.** If GST turnover diverges from bank credits, ask for the sales register and the e-way bills. If a buyer delays beyond the agreed terms twice, stop enhancement and reprice.
